csv_project_name: Engrg for SigOps Traffic Signal Operations Program
csv_scope_of_work: The Georgia Department of Transportation (GDOT) is soliciting Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) from a qualified firm(s) to provide Consultant Services for the projects - SigOps Traffic Signal Operations Program: Contract 1: North Region, including District 1 - Gainesville (except Gwinnett County) and District 6 - Cartersville Contract 2: Southwest Region, including District 3 Thomaston and District 4 - Tifton Contract 3: Southeast Region, including District 2 Tennille and District 5 Jesup
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Inspection Services, Land Use Planning, Electrical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering, Traffic Studies, Transportation Planning
csv_comments: '- Project Number: RFQ484-070926- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 06/17/2026 02:00 PM EDT - Upto Three (3) Firms may be Awarded
title: Engineering for SigOps Traffic Signal Operations Program
short_description: Consultant services for regional traffic signal operations and related transportation engineering in Georgia.
project_location: Gainesville, Georgia, USA; North, Southwest, and Southeast regions of Georgia
project_scope: GDOT seeks consultant services for the SigOps Traffic Signal Operations Program across three regional contracts: Contract 1 North Region including District 1 Gainesville (except Gwinnett County) and District 6 Cartersville; Contract 2 Southwest Region including District 3 Thomaston and District 4 Tifton; Contract 3 Southeast Region including District 2 Tennille and District 5 Jesup. The scope relates to traffic signal operations and transportation engineering support. No specific structural dimensions, bridge spans, or building areas are stated.
services: Consultant services; disciplines requested include landscape architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction/project management, inspection services, land use planning, electrical engineering, structural engineering, traffic design engineering, traffic studies, and transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a traffic signal operations and transportation program, not a bridge, special structure, stadium, or complex building project.
- Includes many non-sbp-core disciplines such as traffic studies, land use planning, inspection, and project management.
- No defined structural scope, spans, long-span roofs, or architecturally demanding structures are described.
- Appears close to transportation operations consulting rather than structural design opportunities relevant to sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. The notice is for consultant services for a traffic signal operations program, with no quantified construction scope from which a realistic construction cost can be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. The procurement is for consultant services and may award up to three firms, but no contract value, budget, or fee basis is provided.
references_qualifications: SOQs are requested from qualified firms. Specific reference requirements or minimum qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided source. Relevant disciplines requested include civil, geotechnical, electrical, structural, traffic design, traffic studies, inspection, planning, and project/construction management.
award_criteria: Not stated in the provided source; procurement is based on Statements of Qualifications (RFQ/SOQ).
